title: Transitivity of Reachability
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-register machine, let an oracle and input be fixed, and let $G$ be a property of configurations. If $A$ reaches $b$ from $a$ in finitely many steps while $G$ holds at every configuration before $b$, and reaches $c$ from $b$ in finitely many steps while $G$ holds at every configuration before $c$, then $A$ reaches $c$ from $a$ in finitely many steps while $G$ holds at every configuration before $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ reaches $b$ from $a$ with $G$ holding at every configuration before $b$
$A$ reaches $c$ from $b$ with $G$ holding at every configuration before $c$
